reference.applicability: Нелинейная нестационарная теплопроводность в 3D, условия 1 или 3 рода на каждой грани. Обычный MC и MC с грубой сеткой вычисляют полное поле на каждой итерации Пикара.
reference.nonlinear_residual: ||A(u)u-rhs(u)||inf / fixed layer scale S; separate from analytic error
reference.timing: Each solve includes preparation, all physical layers, Picard and linear iterations; analytic/Newton references and UI/export are separate. preparation_seconds is a subset of seconds. Block assembly_seconds is included in preparation_seconds; factorization_seconds and solve_seconds are also subsets of seconds, never additional total costs.
reference.memory: workspace_bytes is an estimated numerical working set; peak_rss_bytes is null unless measured, never inferred from workspace_bytes.
reference.reproduction: python -m pdelab.heat3d_cli run --case polynomial --n 6 --alpha 0.5 --dt 0.004 --T 0.007 --query point --methods lod --tol 1e-11 --change-tol 1e-11 --linear-tol 1e-10 --relaxation 1.0 --max-outer 100 --max-inner 20000 --max-seconds 60.0 --max-workspace-bytes 268435456 --point 0 0 0 --x0 3 --beta-x0 1.0 --x1 1 --beta-x1 1.0 --y0 3 --beta-y0 1.0 --y1 1 --beta-y1 1.0 --z0 3 --beta-z0 1.0 --z1 1 --beta-z1 1.0 --newton --out runs/heat3d-run

comparison: signed mean at T minus independent grid Newton, complete series only
